description: Tone control for a stereo signal, balancing the high against the low frequencies

params.text: Counter-clockwise gives a bassy sound, clockwise cuts the bass and lifts the treble
Attenuates and inverts the TONE input before it is added to the TONE knob
Picks one of three modelled tone circuits, marked BASE, DIEZ and PUFF

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input
A control voltage added to the TONE setting, scaled by the TONE attenuverter
The right channel of the audio input

outputs.text: The left channel of the processed signal
The right channel of the processed signal
